source_evidence: These benefits can include tax deductions (e.g., pre-tax contributions), tax-deferred growth (no taxes until withdrawal), and/or tax-free withdrawals.
question: Misconception: Every tax-advantaged account provides tax deductions, tax-deferred growth, and tax-free withdrawals.
answer: These benefits are not necessarily all offered by every account. The source says tax benefits can include deductions, tax-deferred growth, and/or tax-free withdrawals, so the benefits may vary by account.
